blocking.section: Unit and property tests (Required properties, Token Budget row)
blocking.issue: New regression, introduced by applying my earlier non-blocking suggestion, which misread the AI/LLM gateway. The Token Budget property now charges all of R for each attempt that reports no usage. The binding rule is different: pack 8.9 and the AI/LLM gateway Settlement table charge all of R once per request, plus the usage other attempts reported. R per attempt without usage is only a proposal in OQ-ai-llm-gateway-15, and the gateway says 'none applies before it closes'. The property's overshoot bound also leaves out the gateway's '(attempts - 1) x R per concurrent request' term. When a request is charged R + u against a reservation of R, the budget overshoots by up to (attempts - 1) x R. A model-based property that generates Provider Fallback therefore fails a correct implementation, and the per-attempt wording pushes implementers toward the unaccepted OQ-15 proposal.
blocking.evidence: Required properties, line 95: "| Token Budget | R is reserved only if the remaining budget covers it; per attempt, settlement charges reported usage once (all of R if missing) and releases only R's unused part; overshoot stays within the sum of concurrent input-estimate errors (hypothesis; SM-10), plus hidden reasoning above C on `gemini` and `ollama` (OQ-ai-llm-gateway-17) |". AI/LLM gateway, Settlement: "| Attempt reached the provider, no usage read | ... | All of R once per request, plus usage other attempts reported |" and "OQ-ai-llm-gateway-15 also proposes R per attempt lacking usage ... none applies before it closes." Overshoot bound: "... plus (attempts - 1) x R per concurrent request ([Model routing](#model-routing); hypothesis), plus, while OQ-ai-llm-gateway-17 is open, hidden reasoning above C on `gemini` and `ollama`." Pack 8.9 Settlement: "When usage is missing ... charge all of R".
blocking.fix: Replace the Property cell with: 'R is reserved only if the remaining budget covers it; settlement charges each attempt's reported usage once, plus all of R once per request when any attempt that reached the provider reported no usage, and releases the rest of R; overshoot stays within the sum of concurrent input-estimate errors (hypothesis; SM-10), plus (attempts - 1) x R per concurrent request (hypothesis), plus hidden reasoning above C on `gemini` and `ollama` (OQ-ai-llm-gateway-17). If OQ-ai-llm-gateway-15 closes, the property follows it.' The replacement is about 20 words longer, and there is room in the length band.

non_blocking.suggestion: With `GOGC=off`, `-benchmem` microbenchmarks for canonicalization, validation and CEL never free memory. Ten interleaved runs each of the merge base and the head, at the default `-benchtime=1s`, can exhaust a shared runner's memory. Keep `GOGC=off` only around the `testing.AllocsPerRun` checks, or run fixed iteration counts (`-benchtime=Nx`) with a `GOMEMLIMIT` cap.

Macro latency is compared with the previous `nightly` result. A failing night then becomes the next night's baseline, so the regression is accepted from then on. Make the baseline the last passing `nightly` latency result.

non_blocking.suggestion: 'Every seed budget met' makes values tagged (hypothesis) hard release gates: the 1 ms GCRA round trip and the 30 allocations. Say that hypothesis seeds are reported, not gating, until the performance document confirms them. The alternative is that a first release is blocked by an unvalidated number.

The CLI unit tests on windows/amd64 run under the race detector, which needs cgo and a C toolchain on Windows. Name the toolchain the Windows job uses, or run Windows CLI tests without `-race` and under `CGO_ENABLED=0`.

Ruralz Control runs the online stage at ingest, and that stage verifies Plugin signatures (Configuration model; pack 8.14). So RZ-CFG-033 is also raised at Ruralz Control ingest. Write 'RZ-CFG-028 and RZ-CFG-033 also at Ruralz Control ingest'.
The `pr-full` node in Figure 1 lists 'integration, conformance, alloc/op gate' but not the Size gate. The Benchmarks table puts the Size gate in `pr-full`, so add it to the node.
